QuestInfo.1: Vicky doesn't have a specific song in mind, so she wants to listen to a couple different ones. Go to the Music Shop at #b7th and 8th Floor of Kerning Square#k and bring #r35#k #bLatest Hits Compilation#k to Vicky.
QuestInfo.2: You brought Vicky the Latest Hits Compilation but she said the songs are too fast for her.
